summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by G. Willi-Food International Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting its unaudited first-quarter 2026 financial results via a press release. It discloses routine operational metrics: sales of NIS 157.0M (US$49.6M) up 8.3% YoY, gross profit up 9.7%, net profit up 3.0% to NIS 20.1M (US$6.3M), and basic EPS of NIS 1.44. Management comments on strategic execution, product mix, and a logistics center project facing delays due to war. There is no special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring. This is an ordinary earnings announcement filed under Rule 13a-16.
